examples.why_featured: A compact, well-studied cytochrome P450 gives a broadly relevant first look at conservation, standing variation, and cross-species identity.
teaches: Conservation and within-species variation are distinct signals.
A fully accessible locus supports direct inspection of the SNP-density track.
A compact coding gene is a clear introduction to the plots.
limitations: These tracks do not establish resistance phenotype, recent selection, or causal function.
examples.description: A compact plus-strand coding gene with two exons and complete companion accessibility coverage.
examples.qc_note: All 1,690 positions pass the companion accessibility mask.

examples.why_featured: A familiar olfactory co-receptor connects comparative sequence evidence to mosquito sensory and behavioural research.
teaches: A minus-strand gene is displayed in transcriptional orientation.
A longer locus demonstrates adaptive binning.
Conservation and low variation need not rank similarly.
limitations: The displayed sequence signals do not establish olfactory phenotype, host preference, or repellent response.
examples.feature_summary: Olfactory co-receptor on the minus strand
examples.description: A nine-exon minus-strand coding gene spanning 10.8 kb.
examples.qc_note: 9,504 of 10,821 positions (87.8%) pass the companion accessibility mask.

examples.why_featured: A recognizable circadian gene broadens the examples beyond vector-control targets and demonstrates a longer multi-exon locus.
teaches: Alternative isoforms can be inspected without changing the full-gene default.
Range zoom can focus on subregions after one genomic query.
Accessible-base SNP summaries retain explicit denominators.
limitations: The plots do not measure expression, daily rhythmicity, or behavioural timing.
examples.description: A 17.3-kb plus-strand coding gene with two indexed isoforms and fifteen representative exons.
examples.qc_note: 14,526 of 17,275 positions (84.1%) pass the companion accessibility mask.

examples.why_featured: A prominent mosquito immunity gene provides a deliberate example of why accessibility QC must be read before interpreting apparent low variation.
teaches: QC-failed positions are unknown rather than zero.
The 80% accessibility rule can withhold a gene-level SNP ranking.
A multi-exon minus-strand locus remains navigable.
limitations: Only 13.0% of the gene span is accessible in the companion mask, so the whole-gene SNP-density pattern is not representative of most positions.
The sequence tracks do not measure immune phenotype or parasite susceptibility.
examples.feature_summary: Immunity gene with deliberately limited QC
examples.description: A twelve-exon minus-strand coding gene selected as an explicit low-accessibility teaching example.
examples.qc_note: 661 of 5,068 positions (13.0%) pass the companion accessibility mask; the gene-span SNP ranking is withheld.

examples.why_featured: A large voltage-gated sodium-channel locus demonstrates real-world isoform complexity, adaptive binning, range zoom, and partial accessibility.
teaches: Thirteen isoforms can be selected from one indexed gene.
A 73.5-kb locus remains within the 200,000-base browser ceiling.
Exon and gene-span QC eligibility can differ.
limitations: Only 43.3% of the full gene span is accessible, so its gene-span SNP ranking is withheld even though the representative exon union passes the 80% rule.
The plots do not identify resistance mutations or establish target-site resistance.
examples.description: A 73.5-kb plus-strand coding gene with thirteen indexed isoforms and a thirty-exon representative transcript.
examples.qc_note: 31,809 of 73,460 positions (43.3%) pass the companion accessibility mask; the gene-span SNP ranking is withheld.

examples.why_featured: A public pre-miRNA preserves the non-coding renderer and short-locus regression coverage without presenting an unpublished target of interest.
teaches: A non-coding transcript is drawn as an exon without invented CDS or UTR blocks.
Adaptive resolution retains one display bin per base for a 95-bp locus.
Complete accessibility makes the short-locus SNP track interpretable.
limitations: The plots do not establish mature-miRNA processing, targets, expression, or phenotype.
examples.description: A 95-bp single-exon non-coding transcript with no CDS or UTR blocks.
examples.qc_note: All 95 positions pass the companion accessibility mask.

examples.why_featured: The former default remains a compact, high-QC regression locus and provides continuity for established examples.
teaches: A compact three-exon coding model provides a stable technical baseline.
Nearly complete accessibility supports comparison with earlier outputs.
limitations: Its biological relevance is more field-specific than the three quick examples.
examples.description: A compact plus-strand coding gene with three representative exons.
examples.qc_note: 1,653 of 1,685 positions (98.1%) pass the companion accessibility mask.

examples.why_featured: An officially unnamed gene retains a clear multi-isoform example while demonstrating honest symbol fallback behavior.
teaches: Unnamed genes remain identifiable by accession without an invented symbol.
Three transcript models can be compared on chromosome X.
The representative transcript contains seven exons.
limitations: This entry is included for annotation structure rather than a named biological narrative.
examples.feature_summary: Unnamed three-isoform gene on chromosome X
examples.description: Three aligned transcript tracks demonstrate alternative isoforms without inventing an official symbol.
examples.qc_note: 8,520 of 9,569 positions (89.0%) pass the companion accessibility mask.

examples.why_featured: An officially unnamed coding gene provides the deliberate all-QC-failed example used to show that unavailable evidence remains unknown rather than zero.
teaches: Zero accessible bases produce no SNP-density mean or ranking.
Conservation and cross-species identity remain distinct from SNP accessibility.
The interface reports the exact 0/3,424 denominator.
limitations: No within-species variation conclusion can be drawn for this locus from the bundled SNP-density track.
examples.description: A four-exon minus-strand coding gene that demonstrates the explicit unknown state for SNP density.
